title: One-Page Map — Whole Act on One Screen
description:
Displays the entire Slay the Spire 2 act map on one screen instead of scrolling vertically.

What it changes:
- Fits all floors from the start node to the boss (including two-boss acts) into the viewport without scrolling.
- Adds colored outlines around room icons by room type so icons stay readable at smaller scale, and white pulsing borders around rooms you can currently travel to.
- Draws dashed paths between connected rooms. When Compress is checked (on by default), nodes are repositioned horizontally to reduce sharp bends and draw curved paths between columns without changing which rooms connect or adding crossings. Unchecking Compress uses the game's original column positions with straight paths.
- Optional "Hide unreachable nodes" checkbox (off by default) fades rooms that can no longer be reached from your current position.

What stays the same:
- Room connections, travel rules, combat, cards, rewards, and saves are unchanged.
- Uses the game's own map screen, icons, legend, animated bosses, map drawings (draw/erase/clear), quest markers, visited-room tooltips, ink circles, current-position marker, and multiplayer cursors/votes.

Controls:
- M or the top-bar map button: open/close the map.
- F (while the map is open): switch between the one-page view and the default scrolling map.
- ESC / Back: close the map.
- Three checkboxes at the bottom-left (Flat map, Compress, Hide unreachable nodes) are saved between runs. Works with mouse, keyboard, and controller.

Built for Slay the Spire 2 v0.113.1.
changeNote: 0.6.3 — Fixed Start (Ancient) and Boss node coloration in flat mode: both now render in the act's dark ink color over a clean act-colored halo instead of bleaching the Start node white or leaving the Boss node faded before floor 15. Updated Workshop preview screenshot.
